comment: The two build targets the first native release ships (ADR 0020). Runner labels are pinned versioned labels, never *-latest. Image versions and the container digest were read from the official sources below on the resolved date; the workflow consumes the labels and the digest, this file records why they are what they are.

darwin/arm64.note: macos-15 is the conservative pinned label while macos-latest migrates to macOS 26 (completed July 2026). macOS runners are arm64 by default; no Intel variant is built.

linux/amd64.container_note: Pinned by digest (the multi-arch index; Docker selects the amd64 image on the x64 runner), never a mutable tag. The bookworm variant carries git, which actions/checkout needs inside the container.
